Each review contains customer opinion, ratings, and optional images demonstrating real-world usage. The system supports multiple review formats including text, ratings, photo uploads, and seller responses. Reviews are essential for product discovery, seller reputation management, and purchase decision-making support. Prevention of fake reviews and coordinated review campaigns is maintained through automated pattern detection and manual moderation workflows.
